title: PatternSource protocol and usage data models
description: Define the shared abstraction layer in tool/sdd_cli/pattern_usage.py: a PatternSource Protocol with a contribute()/patterns() method plus the dataclasses PatternUsage(pattern_name, specs, refactoring_guru_url, code_locations), SpecRef(spec_id, reason) and CodeLocation(file, line, annotation). These are the types every source and the facade share (Strategy Pattern foundation). Pure data + Protocol, no I/O.

title: CatalogPatternSource over PatternRegistry
description: Implement CatalogPatternSource(PatternSource) in tool/sdd_cli/pattern_usage.py (FR-02). It reads accepted_patterns from _catalog.json exclusively via the existing PatternRegistry (_load_catalog/catalog_summary) — no second JSON reader (DRY). Groups entries by pattern_name, bundling multiple specs (spec_id + reason) per pattern, and emits PatternUsage objects with empty code_locations. Returns an empty list when the catalog is empty.
dependencies: PatternSource protocol and usage data models

title: CodeAnnotationScanner with name normalization
description: Implement CodeAnnotationScanner(PatternSource) in tool/sdd_cli/pattern_usage.py (FR-03, FR-04). Scans the configured source roots (default tool/sdd_cli/ and web/, overridable via patterns.scan_roots in config.yaml) for '<PatternName> Pattern' annotations in comments/docstrings. For each hit it yields a CodeLocation with repo-relative path, line number and the full annotation line. Pattern names are normalized (strip whitespace + lowercase) so 'ChainOfResponsibility' and 'Chain of Responsibility' collapse. No AST/semantic detection — pure text scan.
dependencies: PatternSource protocol and usage data models

title: PatternUsageService facade with merge logic
description: Implement PatternUsageService.usage() -> list[PatternUsage] in tool/sdd_cli/pattern_usage.py (Facade Pattern, FR-05). Iterates over the injected PatternSource list, then merges normalized scanner CodeLocations into the catalog-derived PatternUsage entries: accepted patterns without a hit keep an empty code_locations list; code hits without a catalog entry are ignored (only accepted patterns surface). Covers TST-0217 cases: merge with/without location, empty catalog.

title: GET /api/patterns route
description: Add web/api/routes/patterns.py exposing GET /api/patterns (FR-01, CON-0184). The thin route delegates to PatternUsageService.usage() and serializes the list as [{pattern_name, specs:[{spec_id, reason}], refactoring_guru_url, code_locations:[{file, line, annotation}]}]. Returns an empty array (not an error) for an empty catalog. No aggregation logic in the HTTP layer (SRP).

title: Register patterns route in the web API app
description: Wire web/api/routes/patterns.py into the application router so GET /api/patterns is reachable, mirroring how the existing routes are registered. Per Backend Sync, ensure the change lands in both web/api/ and the tool/sdd_cli/web/api/ copy.

title: api.ts getPatterns client function
description: Add a getPatterns() client function to web/ui/src/api.ts that calls GET /api/patterns and returns typed PatternUsage[] (pattern_name, specs, refactoring_guru_url, code_locations), consistent with the existing AI-usage client function. Export the TypeScript types for reuse by the view.

title: PatternsView presentation logic module
description: Extract the pure view logic of the Patterns view into web/ui/src/patternsViewLogic.ts (FR-06, TST-0218): grouping/sorting patterns for display, deriving the empty-state flag when the list is empty, and mapping a code_location to the OpenButton target (file + line). DOM-free so it is unit-testable without a render framework.

title: PatternsView component and Patterns nav entry
description: Build the read-only PatternsView component in web/ui/src/ using AiUsageView.tsx as the structural template (FR-06): one card per pattern showing name, using specs via IdChip, the external refactoring_guru_url link, and the code_locations list with clickable OpenButton entries. Renders a friendly empty-state when the catalog is empty. Add the 'Patterns' nav entry that routes to this view.
